changelog:
claude-mem v1.0.1 changelog:

- Initial public release of the claude-mem OpenClaw plugin and worker service.
- Added full setup documentation and quick install script.
- Included end-to-end tests, install scripts, and TypeScript sources for plugin logic.
- Sample skills added: do-plan and make-plan, each with their own setup guides.
- Provided automated and manual setup options for persistent agent memory with memory file sync and observation feed.
summary: Enables persistent agent memory with a live-updating MEMORY.md file and optional real-time observation feed streaming via OpenClaw.
